messages:
nina: Heads up  ran a quick audit and there are revoke ops being billed to the org owner instead of the SA project after the delegated-token rollout. Anyone else?

omar: Saw a couple spikes on billing attribution this morning. Traced one to the console revoke flow.

devon: Repro steps: Console -> Roles -> Revoke -> confirm. If the short-lived exchange uses the proxy path the `origin_project` header gets normalized away.

nina: Interestingwe thought the proxy preserved signed headers. Did a quick trace and proxy rewrite happens in the cold-path when auth-cache miss occurs.

omar: Sampling tweak last week made this surface because we started sampling different traces. Previously noise hid it.

devon: Quick mitigation options: (1) API fallback: if token lacks project claim consult authn-cache for last effective identity (canary). (2) Console: attach signed `X-Origin-Project` on revoke requests. (3) Medium: token_v2 with `pjt` claim bound to token.

nina: I like 1 + 2 for immediate. 3 planned for Q2 since it needs migration and token-versioning.

omar: Also add metric `auth_attribution_fallback_total` + a new Billing dashboard card: "Attribution source: token | fallback | proxy" so support can quickly triage.

devon: UX ask: put a one-line audit in the revoke modal: "Revoking as: service-account X (project Y)  charges billed to project Y". Saves a ticket per noisy customer.

eng-bot: action: create INC-2026-delegated-claim-leak (priority: P2). Add runbook link and rollback steps.

nina: I'll canary the API fallback in api-gateway today. Set alert: `auth_attrib_fallback_rate > 0.2%` of revoke traffic -> page oncall.

omar: I'll do the console header PR and a tiny e2e to assert header is present end-to-end even when proxy rewrites.

devon: For the medium-term token_v2 plan: we need `token_v` header, dual-acceptor in services, and a migration window where both claim styles are trusted. I'll draft the migration doc.

eng-bot: deploy queued: api-gateway fallback (canary) -> expected 12m to green.

nina: After fallback stable we'll run a backfill reclass job for last 72h telemetry to correct billing dashboards.

omar: Also add a short-lived Grafana card under Console -> Billing showing per-hour fallback counts with links to sample traces.

devon: One more: add unit test in auth-proxy to assert that signed project header is preserved when present, fail build if regression.

ui: Drafting the revoke modal copy now, posting figma link in 30m. Suggest tiny tooltip: "Identity used for billing is determined at request start. Contact support if incorrect".

nina: Great. I'll monitor canary and post updates. If fallback spikes we'll revert router changes. :thumbsup:
